name: gnome-packagekit
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: gnome-packagekit presents a modal warning when PackageKit reports an untrusted package and asks the user whether to continue; verification is performed by the PackageKit backend.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
